packageRules.description: Automerge chore dep updates (digest, pin, patch, minor) when CI passes
Do not SHA-pin projectbluefin/actions refs — they use @v1 managed tags enforced by no-sha-pins-for-internal-actions pre-commit hook

Do not SHA-pin projectbluefin/testsuite refs — run-testsuite.yml uses the @v1 managed tag so E2E picks up testsuite fixes immediately; a digest pin here delays every fix by a Renovate cycle (see #989)
